explanation: This is safe. The malloc result is null-checked, and free(tmp) runs on every path before either return — the write-failure branch falls through to the free rather than skipping it, so the buffer is always released and there is no leak. A tempting wrong answer assumes an early return on failure abandons the allocation.
prompt: write_name() frees tmp before returning. Is the buffer leaked when fputs fails?
right_label: Leaks tmp when the write fails
